#### **Feature Engineering**

The code chunk below contains the required data manipulation and variable engineering required to answer and understand the dashboard.

```{r}
db_data <- raw_data |>
  
  # date
  mutate(
    match_date = format(start_date, "%d/%m/%y")
  ) |>
  relocate(match_date, .after = season) |>
  
  
  # remove / relocate unnecessary variables
  relocate(start_date, .after = fielder_3) |>
  select(
    -penalty,
    -other_wicket_type
  ) |>
  
  
  # over
  mutate(
    over = floor(actual_delivery) + 1
  ) |>
  relocate(over, .after = actual_delivery) |>
  
  
  # rearrange important delivery variables
  relocate(
    runs_off_bat,
    extras,
    wides,
    noballs,
    byes,
    legbyes,
    wicket_type,
    .after = over
  ) |>
  
  # phase of the game
  mutate(
    Phase_over = case_when(
      over <= 6 ~ "Powerplay",
      over <= 16 ~ "Mid-Game",
      over <= 20 ~ "Death"
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(Phase_over, .after = over) |>
  
  #delivery order
  arrange(start_date, match_id, innings) |> 
   group_by(match_id,
            innings) |>
  mutate(delivery_order = row_number() ) |>
  
  ungroup() |>
  
   # target runs
  left_join(
    raw_data_1 |>
      select(match_id, target_runs),
    by = "match_id") |>
  relocate(target_runs, .after = innings) |>
  
  # wicket on current delivery
  mutate(
    wicket_this_ball = case_when(
      is.na(wicket_type) ~ 0,
      wicket_type == "retired hurt" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1) ) |>
  relocate(
    wicket_this_ball, .after = wicket_type) |>
  
  #replace NA with 0
  mutate(
    extras = ifelse(is.na(extras), 0, extras),
    wides = ifelse(is.na(wides), 0, wides),
    noballs = ifelse(is.na(noballs), 0, noballs),
    byes = ifelse(is.na(byes), 0, byes),
    legbyes = ifelse(is.na(legbyes), 0, legbyes) 
    ) |>
  
  # runs on current delivery
  mutate(runs_this_ball = runs_off_bat + extras) |>
  relocate(
    runs_this_ball, .after = wicket_this_ball) |>
  
  
  #rearrange main match variables
  relocate(
    innings,
    target_runs,
    ball,
    actual_delivery,
    over,
    Phase_over,
    wides,
    noballs,
    byes,
    legbyes,
    extras,
    wicket_this_ball,
    wicket_type,
    runs_off_bat,
    runs_this_ball,
    .after = match_date
  ) |>
  
  #cumulative match score
  group_by(match_id, innings) |>
  mutate(
    cumulative_runs = cumsum(runs_this_ball),
    cumulative_wickets = cumsum(wicket_this_ball),
    score = paste0(
      cumulative_runs,
      "/",
      cumulative_wickets
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  # cumulative extras
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cumulative_extras = cumsum(extras),
    cumulative_wides = cumsum(wides),
    cumulative_noballs = cumsum(noballs),
    cumulative_byes = cumsum(byes),
    cumulative_legbyes = cumsum(legbyes) ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  
   # phase cumulative score
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings,
    Phase_over
  ) |>
  mutate(
    phase_runs = cumsum(runs_this_ball),
    phase_wickets = cumsum(wicket_this_ball),
    phase_extras = cumsum(extras),
    phase_wides = cumsum(wides),
    phase_noballs = cumsum(noballs),
    phase_byes = cumsum(byes),
    phase_legbyes = cumsum(legbyes) ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  
  #legal delivery
  mutate(
    legal_ball = case_when(
      !is.na(wides) & wides > 0 ~ 0,
      !is.na(noballs) & noballs > 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  
  #cumulative legal deliveries
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cumulative_legal_balls = cumsum(legal_ball)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  # runs, wickets before current ball
  mutate(
    runs_before_ball = cumulative_runs - runs_this_ball,
    wickets_before_ball = cumulative_wickets - wicket_this_ball
  ) |>
  relocate(
    runs_before_ball,
    .after = runs_this_ball
  ) |>
  relocate(
    wickets_before_ball,
    .after = wicket_this_ball
  ) |>

  
  #current team run rate
  mutate(
    team_run_rate = case_when(
      cumulative_legal_balls > 0 ~
        (cumulative_runs / cumulative_legal_balls) * 6,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

### Feature Engineering

The raw BBL dataset mainly contained ball-by-ball delivery data, along with a separate match-level dataset. Before starting the analysis, I created a few additional variables that were needed to understand the match situation properly and to build the dashboard.

First, I organised the delivery data in the correct order for each match and innings. I created the match date, over number, and also divided the innings into three phases: **Powerplay, Mid-Game and Death overs**. I also created a delivery order variable so that every ball could be analysed in the correct sequence.

The target runs were then added from the match-level dataset. I created a variable to identify whether a wicket occurred on each delivery and another variable to calculate the total runs scored on that ball. Missing values for extras such as wides, no-balls, byes and leg-byes were replaced with zero where required.

After this, I calculated cumulative values for each innings, including total runs, wickets and extras. This helped me track how the match was progressing after every delivery. I also created variables for runs and wickets before the current ball, which were later required for the pressure analysis.

I also calculated cumulative runs, wickets and extras separately within each phase of the innings. These engineered variables were then used for the scoring-rate analysis, wicket analysis and the pressure-based batter analysis in the dashboard.
